title: How the US Helped Israel Get Away With Killing Hind Rajab: Insiders Explain
author: Prem Thakker
content:
Two years ago, the world heard a 6-year-old girl in Gaza begging for help
after Israeli forces shot her family, murdered the paramedics sent to save
her, and then killed her, too. Millions of people know [Hind
Rajab](https://zeteo.com/p/hind-killing-israel-biden-legacy-gaza)'s name, but
her killing was never investigated, not by the US nor by Israel.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Why not? What broke down inside the institutions that _should_ have held
Israel accountable - like the US State Department and US humanitarian
agencies?

Where better to answer those questions than on Capitol Hill, with insiders who
saw the accountability system in the US fail in real time? **Zeteo 's Prem
Thakker** sat down to moderate a panel discussion after a screening of the
powerful film '[The Voice of Hind
Rajab](https://www.thevoiceofhindrajabfilm.com/),' hosted by **Rep. Pramila
Jayapal** and **Sen. Peter Welch**.

[Share](https://zeteo.com/p/how-the-us-helped-israel-get-
away?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)

Watch the **full video above** to hear…

  * **Amanda Klasing** of Amnesty International USA on the ways the US government **" could actually **_**really**_**push for accountability, and just didn 't."**

  * **Josh Paul** , who [resigned](https://zeteo.com/p/aipac-is-israel-first-and-that-is) from Biden's administration in protest over Gaza, on what's next: **" All of that pain, there is a voice calling on us, and we must act."**

  * Palestinian-American actor **Clara Khoury** on portraying **" the worst moment of someone's life,"** and her reaction to hearing Hind's voice for the first time.
